purpose: Define the minimum authoritative geometry required for Beagle corridor entities without promoting census units, historic road lines, inferred coordinates, or visualization products as current canonical truth.
governing_principle: The agent interprets and contextualizes; the source accredits.

ine_censo_2024_region_12.producer: Instituto Nacional de Estadísticas de Chile
ine_censo_2024_region_12.dataset_title: Cartografía Censo 2024 — Región de Magallanes y de la Antártica Chilena
ine_censo_2024_region_12.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 under INE open-data terms

mop_red_vial_2013.producer: Dirección de Vialidad, Ministerio de Obras Públicas
mop_red_vial_2013.warning: Working database; the layer states that it does not represent the legal nature of the roads.

geometry_roles.source_geometry: Unmodified feature retrieved from the producing dataset.
geometry_roles.contextual_geometry: Dated geometry used to explain the scope of a source, never presented as a timeless boundary.
geometry_roles.representative_point: Authoritative named-place point or separately documented derivation used for map labels and navigation.
geometry_roles.operational_geometry: Geometry whose current usability or condition has been verified by the competent live source.

allowed_methods: point-on-surface derived from the approved Censo 2024 urban polygon
required_outputs.note: A derived point must retain the polygon source, transformation algorithm, software/version, CRS and derivation timestamp.

targets.name_collision_rule: Do not merge the urban entity with the rural locality also named Puerto Williams.

required_outputs.disallowed_derivation: Do not derive a settlement point from the centroid of the broad rural census polygon.
preferred_source_order: IDE Chile or IGM named-place feature
competent Chilean public producer with explicit feature provenance

provenance_required_for_any_derived_file: distribution and original filename or service URL
attribution_template: Fuente: Instituto Nacional de Estadísticas de Chile, Cartografía Censo 2024 — Región de Magallanes y de la Antártica Chilena. Derivación de Austral Beacon; cambios indicados. Licencia CC BY-SA 4.0.
promotion_gates: The semantic role of the geometry is explicit.
The source feature can be selected reproducibly.
License and attribution obligations are satisfied.
Any transformation is reproducible and recorded.
The geometry is not used to infer access, schedules, road condition or service availability.
A human review confirms that the map label and legend preserve the source's temporal and statistical meaning.
next_actions: Locate an authoritative named-place point for Puerto Toro.
Decide whether Puerto Williams needs a first-party point or a point-on-surface derivation.
Locate a current MOP road distribution with explicit reuse terms before adopting Y-905 linework.
Prepare a separate implementation PR only after these decisions are approved.
